_doc: Metropolitan Museum programme items of the first run (archive.org copies) matched to catalogued Library of Congress records (met_to_catalogue.json) and confirmed by looking at both images; geometry from tie_geometry.py.

MMET268204.note: the left plate of a two-plate panorama: it covers the left half of the Library print (the footprint spans 0.00 to 0.53 of its width); the print joins the two plates; geometry (tie_geometry.py): SAME_PLATE, inlier fraction 0.909, scale 0.518, median residual 0.27 px

MMET268205.note: the right plate of the same panorama: it covers the right part of the Library print (the footprint spans 0.45 to 0.96 of its width); it overlaps the left plate by about 0.08 of the print; geometry (tie_geometry.py): SAME_PLATE, inlier fraction 0.909, scale 0.52, median residual 0.21 px

MMET268201.note: the same scene as the Library negative (a white house with an outside stair); inlier fraction 0.58 and median residual 2.1 px, so the same exposure or its stereo sibling; geometry (tie_geometry.py): SAME_SCENE, inlier fraction 0.577, scale 1.135, median residual 2.13 px, failed inlier_fraction, anisotropy

MMET268202.note: a pond with a broken rail fence and a man; the same photograph as ppmsca.32833 and as ppmsca.32852 (record 2012647718): 619 and 586 inliers, residual under 1 px; geometry (tie_geometry.py): SAME_PLATE, inlier fraction 0.961, scale 1.098, median residual 0.68 px

MMET268203.note: two men standing in a field in front of a wood; the same photograph as ppmsca.32840 and ppmsca.32853 (record 2012647719): 1154 and 725 inliers, residual under 1 px; geometry (tie_geometry.py): SAME_PLATE, inlier fraction 0.995, scale 1.029, median residual 0.43 px

MMET286882.note: a print of dead soldiers lying on a field, mounted on a page with printed text; the same photograph as ppmsca.32922 (886 inliers); it also matches the negative cwpb.00849 of record 2018666307 (274 inliers); geometry (tie_geometry.py): SAME_PLATE, inlier fraction 0.981, scale 1.331, median residual 0.47 px
